Sierra AI - Bret Taylor's conversational platform came out of stealth. Kind of underwhelming. Was expecting something more innovative. Also a competitor to OpenAI which he's on the board of. Slightly weird to say the least.

Having seen this set up for a customer, what is interesting is how it works with internal APIs for customers. It's all point and click in a simple UI -- add a UI, describe how the agent can work with it, and get the agent set up and working.

The magic isn't in a new LLM technology, it is in reliably productionizing a solution for real-world problems... fill in the gap of missing web forms for processes that customers don't yet have access to, that currently fall to human support teams.
